# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment

Iteration 1 was accepted as the new best: it reduced usage to 30 LUTs and 40 FFs, with routed WNS 0.315 ns and WHS 0.197 ns. Timing is feasible, so iteration 2 must strictly improve the LUT objective while passing the fixed behavioral and verification gates; the top must retain `// @latency 9`.

## Hypothesis

Sizing the iteration counter to the supported `WIDTH` may remove unnecessary counter state and logic, with a possible LUT reduction and no change to the divider schedule.

## Instruction for generator

Replace the fixed `reg [4:0] iteration` with a counter sized to represent `0` through `WIDTH-1`, using a minimum width of one bit for `WIDTH=1`; keep the existing capture reset, per-compute increment, and terminal comparison. Preserve exactly `WIDTH` compute edges, result availability and retirement timing, reset behavior, and all arithmetic for supported `WIDTH` values 1 through 16. Retain the top interface and `// @latency 9`; this is a resource hypothesis, so keep the candidate only if routed metrics show a strict objective improvement and all required gates pass.
